About

Trevor Jones is a Chicago-based bassist and co-founder of Double Bass HQ. He serves as House Bassist and Music Coordinator at the Marriott Theatre in Lincolnshire, IL, where he has played on dozens of productions. He also freelances widely across the Chicago area and writes and performs in the alternative rock band Molehill, which has toured nationally and earned coverage in the Chicago Tribune.
